entities.name: ord-77f78c85003d4a0d8623ef325b53e7da
observations: Exact ORD reaction converts a methyl aryl ester, Ar-C(=O)-OCH3, to the corresponding carboxylic acid, Ar-C(=O)-OH.
The amide, difluoroalkyl substituent, and fused hydrocarbon ring system are unchanged.
Reaction class is base-promoted methyl-ester saponification/deprotection.
Recorded components are KOH, water, and methanol; specific temperature, time, and isolated yield were not available.

entities.name: KOH water methanol
observations: Potassium hydroxide in water and methanol is recorded for hydrolysis of the methyl ester to a carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: The mapped transformation cleaves the ester O-CH3 bond and replaces the methyl ester with a carboxylic acid.
The most likely operational sequence is aqueous alcoholic KOH hydrolysis followed by acidification during workup.
